relations.subject: eventing:on-delete-handler
relations.evidence: Note since the document is not available during an OnDelete we will filter by KEY prefix starting with `"tosync:".*`. This is a hard coded implementation.

cross_component_finding: OnDelete's lack of document-body access forces this handler to fall back to KEY-prefix filtering ('tosync:') instead of the doc.type filter used by every OnUpdate handler in this batch - the same on-delete-handler/on-update-handler asymmetry already registered via the sibling delete-vs-expiry pages, now shown from a 'keep two collections in sync' angle rather than cascade-delete.
cross_product_finding: Recurrence of the destination-collection/XCDR hand-off note seen elsewhere in this batch (redactSharedData) and in the sibling batch (genericFlatten): "The \"destination\" collection can be shared (or replicated via XCDR to a business partner) too the cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP)." Same pattern, not a new finding.
